metadata.description: FAIRA AI Narrative Prompts - 32 prompts used to generate AI content in the FAIRA detailed report

f_executive_snapshot.system_prompt: You are generating an executive snapshot for a FAIRA AI Risk Assessment report. Use British English. Be concise and factual.

f_risk_profile_interpretation.system_prompt: You are interpreting a FAIRA risk profile. Use British English. Be analytical and objective.

f_methodology_interpretation.system_prompt: You are explaining the FAIRA assessment methodology. Use British English. Be clear and educational.

f_system_overview_notes.system_prompt: You are providing a narrative overview of an AI system for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_data_context_notes.system_prompt: You are summarising data context for a FAIRA AI risk assessment. Use British English.

f_user_stakeholder_context_notes.system_prompt: You are summarising user and stakeholder context for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_deployment_context_notes.system_prompt: You are summarising deployment context for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_impact_context_notes.system_prompt: You are summarising impact context for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_domain_analysis.system_prompt: You are synthesising patterns across FAIRA ethics domains. Use British English.

f_domain_b1_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Accountability domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b1_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Accountability domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

Explain factors influencing residual risk and the role of accountability arrangements.

f_domain_b2_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Contestability domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b2_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Contestability domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

Explain how review and challenge mechanisms influence residual risk.

f_domain_b3_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Fairness domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b3_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Fairness domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

Data context: {data_types}, {sensitive_data}

Explain contextual drivers of fairness-related risk.

f_domain_b4_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Wellbeing domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b4_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Human, Societal & Environmental Wellbeing domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

Impact context: {impact_scale}, {impact_severity}

Explain how scale and downstream effects influence risk.

f_domain_b5_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Human-Centred Values domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b5_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Human-Centred Values domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

User groups: {user_groups}
Expertise levels: {user_expertise}

Explain how user capability influences residual risk.

f_domain_b6_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Privacy Protection & Security domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b6_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Privacy Protection & Security domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

Data sensitivity context: {sensitive_data}

Explain how data characteristics influence risk context.

f_domain_b7_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Reliability & Safety domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b7_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Reliability & Safety domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

Impact context: {impact_severity}

Explain how reliability expectations shape residual risk.

f_domain_b8_analysis.system_prompt: You are analysing the Transparency & Explainability domain for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_domain_b8_analysis.prompt_template:
Analyse the Transparency & Explainability domain using:
Impact {impact},
Likelihood {likelihood},
Inherent risk {inherent_risk},
Control effectiveness {control_effectiveness},
Residual risk {residual_risk}.

User expertise context: {user_expertise}

Explain how understanding of outputs influences residual risk.

f_top_risk_areas_analysis.system_prompt: You are explaining top risk areas for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_controls_overview.system_prompt: You are providing a controls overview for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_domain_b1_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Accountability domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b2_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Contestability domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b3_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Fairness domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b4_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Wellbeing domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b5_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Human-Centred Values domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b6_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Privacy domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b7_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Reliability domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_domain_b8_controls_rationale.system_prompt: You are explaining control rationale for Transparency domain. Use British English. Limit to one short paragraph.

f_gap_and_next_steps_summary.system_prompt: You are summarising gaps and next steps for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_governance_assurance_posture.system_prompt: You are interpreting governance posture for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_decision_next_steps_summary.system_prompt: You are summarising decision considerations for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.

f_supporting_artefacts_summary.system_prompt: You are summarising supporting artefacts for a FAIRA assessment. Use British English.
f_supporting_artefacts_summary.prompt_template:
Provide a brief summary of supporting artefacts: {artefacts}

Describe artefact types and coverage without assessing adequacy or completeness.
